verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a first-party quotas page that explains how to view quotas in the Cloud Console, how to read quota errors when a Node Pool exceeds its quota, and how to request an increase. That covers the core of the story. The evidence is only a page summary, though, so the actual limit values and the steps of the increase process are not documented in the pack. Missing for 10: published per-instance-type limit values, details of the increase-request process (channel, turnaround, approval criteria), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process
